name: lightningcss
description: Guest shim for lightningcss 1.32.0: costs nothing at require and instantiates lightningcss-wasm (15.9 MB) on the first transform/bundle call. The Vite + Tailwind dev server imports lightningcss at startup and never calls it. Needs only WebAssembly and fs. Normally laid over an installed lightningcss-wasm (see package.overlay.json and the guest policy); this manifest is for using the directory as a package of its own.
